profile.what: Finished-dose generic medicines made in India (60% in-house, 40% outsourced from Indian and Chinese contract makers) and sold mainly through its own subsidiaries, warehouses and sales teams in Central and South America and the Caribbean (76% of FY26 revenue), French-speaking Africa (3%), and US sterile injectables and ophthalmics through Caplin Steriles (21%).

guidance.what: Caplin Steriles (US + regulated) to grow 25-30% in FY27; own label (Caplin Steriles USA) to ~₹200 cr from ~₹100 cr
Gross margin to stay ~60% through FY27 (commitment 55% contribution, 25% PAT)
PAT margin 26-29% for the next 18 months (gestation and consolidation as Mexico, Chile, Colombia and oncology ramp); tax ~21%
PAT 27-28% and EBITDA incl. other income 38-39% despite API unit and Amaris not breaking even; numbers to hold or inch up 18-24 months out
Effective tax rate ~20% (Q1FY27 20.5% in line with target)
Capex: ₹510 cr of the ~₹1,000 cr programme left, to be spent over 18-24 months from internal accruals; excludes Mexico, Chile warehouses, QC lab
Receivables comfortable at 100-130 days; Q1 build (₹46 cr, government supplies) to be collected by Q3FY27; CFO to improve from Q2
Line 7 at Caplin Steriles in 6-7 months; five more lines (COL-II, Phase 3) by about Aug-2027; 3-4 further lines by FY29 and beyond; 9-10 months to move a US product to a new line
Launch 12 more US products in FY27 (10 under own label); first pre-filled syringe filing in FY27, 14+ in FY28; 60+ non-US filings in 18 months
Mexico: buy a distributor (3-4 candidates under review); plant on land bought in Toluca, construction from mid-2027 (₹100-125 cr); 120+ filings in 18 months on top of 29 approvals

points: Company "EBITDA" includes other income (FY26 ₹876 cr = ₹761 cr operating + ₹116 cr other income); we use Screener operating profit.
No exceptional items in the company P&L; Screener treats part of FY26 other income (~₹13 cr pre-tax, mostly realised gains on investments) as exceptional.
FX translation of the Latin American subsidiaries went straight to reserves (+₹141 cr in FY26); 11 of 136 receivable days at Mar-26 were translation (CFO).
Screener files the ₹216.6 cr CCPS as borrowings; the company as owners' equity. Neither attributes any Caplin Steriles profit to the CCPS holders.
Employee stock options: a ₹1.35 cr reversal in FY26 (₹9.38 cr charge in FY25).
